stwpatch for Windows

1. Close Stormworks.
2. Extract the whole archive (anywhere, even into the game folder: the patch files
   are named stwpatch_*.dll and never overwrite a game file), then double-click install.bat (Steam folder found automatically), or run:
     install.bat "D:\SteamLibrary\steamapps\common\Stormworks"
   Add "server" at the end to also patch the dedicated server (server64.exe, via opengl32.dll).
   steam_api64.dll is NEVER modified: the game checks it (anti-piracy).
3. Play. Logs: stwpatch.log, stwpatch_physics_peak.txt in the game folder.

If the game crashes: start it once more (it starts in SAFE MODE, without patches,
after a crash during startup), then send stwpatch.log and crash.dmp from the game folder.
If Windows Defender removes OpenAL64.dll, add an exclusion for the game folder.
uninstall.bat restores the original DLLs.
